types.title: SummaryCardData
types.description: Data of a summary_card widget: one row per line, in delivered order.

rows.description: One row per line, in delivered order.

reference_value.description: Optional value the headline is compared with, such as last week's, shown under it with the difference: absolute, and in percent when the reference is not 0. The difference is coloured by the render's better rule, as the trend is. Absent or null shows no comparison.

rows.description: Rows in the delivered order. secondary is omitted when the data has no secondary value; status and href are optional.

status.description: Optional status of the row, shown as a badge after its label, toned by the render's status_tones (neutral when it names none). Null or absent shows no badge.

href.description: Optional link target of the row: its label becomes a link, checked by the shared link rule (https, http, mailto, or a path from the site root (/x, not //x)). A refused target shows the label as text. Null or absent shows no link.

goal.description: Optional goal of the row: a mark on its bar at goal over target, and the goal in the bar's text alternative and tooltip. The bar runs from 0 to target: a goal outside it extends nothing, its mark stands at the nearer end and the text says it is outside the bar; with a null or zero target the goal shows in the text alone. Null or absent shows no goal.

types.title: GridData
types.description: Data of a grid widget. One positional array per row, in display order. A position that holds no value holds null.

rows.description: One positional array per row, in the order of render.columns. A position that holds no value holds null. Capped at 500 rows; an over-cap result fails data validation.

oneOf.description: A link: its text, and its target, checked by the shared link rule of the widgets: https, http, mailto, or a path from the site root (/x, not //x). Any other target shows the text alone. A link to another origin opens in a new tab; any other link opens in the same tab.
A sparkline: one point per step, a null point being a gap. Allowed in a sparkline column only: in any other column it fails the grid's own check.

types.title: CartesianChartData
types.description: Data of a cartesian_chart widget, in long format.

series.description: One entry per series, each with its name and points.

x.description: On a value axis, a number. On a time axis, an ISO 8601 date-time string, a bare YYYY-MM-DD date read as its UTC midnight (a date of the calendar: 2026-02-30 fails), or a number of epoch milliseconds. On a category axis, any value. A mismatch is checked by the widget.

y.description: On a series of a log y axis, above zero. A y not above zero there is checked by the widget.

size.description: A scatter series only (on another type, a cross-check the widget runs): the point's size; its area grows in proportion to it, within the radius range the widget sets. Null or absent draws the smallest point.

slices.description: One slice per segment, in delivered order.

rows.description: One row per cell value. An omitted y counts as null.

types.title: SummaryCardRender
types.description: Render of a summary_card widget. It has no presentation fields, so render is an empty object.

types.title: MetricCardRender
types.description: Render of a metric_card widget: its presentation fields, closed.

value_label.description: Optional caption of the headline value. Without it, no caption shows.

better.description: Optional direction of an improvement, which sets the trend's colour: higher (the default) paints a rise as success and a fall as danger; lower paints a fall as success and a rise as danger, for numbers where less is better such as lead time; neutral paints every change in the neutral (secondary) badge, for numbers where neither direction is better. The icon and its accessible name always follow the value's own direction.

reference_label.description: Optional name of reference_value, such as Last week, written before it. Without it, Reference.

href.description: The link's target, checked by the shared link rule: https, http, mailto, or a path from the site root (/x, not //x). Any other target shows the text alone. A link to another origin opens in a new tab.

link.description: Optional link at the card's foot.

types.title: RankedListCardRender
types.description: Render of a ranked_list_card widget: its presentation fields, closed.

value_label.description: Optional heading of the primary value.

secondary_label.description: Optional heading of the secondary value.

status_tones.description: Optional tone of each row status value; a status with no tone draws neutral.

types.title: ProgressListCardRender
types.description: Render of a progress_list_card widget: its presentation fields, closed.

goal_label.description: Optional name of a row goal, in the bar's text alternative and tooltip. Without it, Goal.

types.title: GridRender
types.description: Render of a grid widget: its presentation fields, closed.

columns.description: Displayed columns, in display order. Each describes one data position. The consistency checks are validated by cpt-frontx-dashboard-algo-widget-catalog-grid-checks.

key.description: Unique column key. column_groups[].members and row_color refer to this key.

width.description: Optional width in pixels. The table is at least as wide as the sum of its column widths, counting 160 pixels for a column without one; a grid wider than its cell scrolls sideways inside it.

format.description: Optional number format. notation applies to number-valued cells of a text or badge column only: standard shows the full number and compact shows the abbreviated number of the host language. A progress column shows a percent and takes no format.

align.description: Optional alignment of the column body, in logical terms: start and end follow the writing direction of the host language.

sortable.description: Whether a click on the header sorts by this column. Without it, true, except in a sparkline column, which never sorts: there it is false, and true fails the grid's own check. A badge column sorts by its text, a progress column by its number.

overflow.description: wrap shows the whole value on as many lines as it needs; truncate keeps one line per cell, ends a long value in an ellipsis and keeps its full text as the cell's title. Without it, wrap.

kind.description: Optional way a cell draws its value. text (the default) shows it as text. badge shows a string as a badge toned by tones (null or a blank string is an empty cell). progress shows a number from 0 to 1 as a bar with its percent as text (null is an empty cell; a value that is not a number or lies outside 0 to 1 fails the grid's own check). sparkline shows a list of numbers or nulls as a small line in the theme's chart colour, with no axes, its text alternative naming the first, last, lowest and highest values (null is an empty cell; a value that is not a list fails the grid's own check). Without it, text.

tones.description: Optional tone of each value of a badge column; a value with no tone draws neutral. Allowed with kind badge only: with any other kind it fails the grid's own check.

page_sizes.description: Optional page sizes offered. The first entry is the initial page size. Defaults to [10, 25, 50, 100, 500].

frozen_columns.description: Number of leading columns that stay visible during horizontal scrolling. 0 or absent freezes no column. More than the column count freezes all.

column_groups.description: Grouped column headings. A heading only: it never reorders rows or collapses columns.

row_color.description: Optional column key. Its value in a row names the row colour: success, warning, error, or info.

search.description: Optional search box above the grid. It keeps the rows whose shown text (formatted numbers, badge text, progress percents and link text; sparklines are not searched) contains the typed text, ignoring case, in any column, and shows the first page. Without it, false.

types.title: CartesianChartRender
types.description: Render of a cartesian_chart widget: its presentation fields, closed.

series.description: How each data series is drawn. A data series without an entry here draws as bars on the primary y axis.

name.description: The series name, matching a series name in the data.

y_axis.description: Which y axis the series uses. Without it, the primary axis.

stack_group.description: Optional stack group. Series with the same stack group on the same y axis are stacked in delivered order: bars and areas together, lines together.

label.description: A line or area only: a name written at the end of the series, at its last point, for example a target.

line_style.description: A line or area only. Without it, solid.

mark_extremes.description: A line or area only (on another type, a cross-check the widget runs, cpt-frontx-dashboard-algo-widget-catalog-cartesian-checks): a mark with its value on the series' lowest point, highest point, or both; of equal values, the first point in axis order (the drawn order), skipping nulls.

label.description: A title written under the x axis ticks, and the x column heading of the data view and the text alternative.

tick_labels.description: auto skips tick labels that would collide; every labels each category, thinning out to every second, third and so on only when the labels cannot fit; a value or time axis has no categories, so there every acts as auto. Without it, auto.

tick_angle.description: Rotation of the tick labels in degrees; a tilted axis grows to fit them. Without it, 0.

label.description: A title written along the primary y axis, outside its ticks.

y_axis_secondary.description: Settings of the secondary y axis, used by series whose y_axis is secondary.

label.description: A title written along the secondary y axis, outside its ticks.

unit.description: Written after every tick value of the secondary axis, for example %.

legend_position.description: none hides the legend. Without it, bottom.

value_labels.description: Values written at the end of the bars (above a bar that grows up, below one that grows down; a zero bar has none): always, never, or auto when every bar is wide enough for its value. Without it, never.

drill_down.description: Whether the chart offers its data view and opens it from a click on a mark. Without it, false.

orientation.description: horizontal puts the categories on the vertical axis and the values on the horizontal one, for every series type; it needs a category x axis (a cross-check the widget runs). tick_angle does not apply to a horizontal chart. Without it, vertical.

stack_mode.description: percent draws each stack group as shares of 100% at each x, its axis in percents and the tooltip with the value and its share. Every series on such an axis is in a stack group, no stacked value is negative (cross-checks the widget runs), and an x where a group sums to 0 draws 0% for each member. Without it, absolute.

size_label.description: The name of a scatter point's size, in the tooltip and the data view column. Without it, Size.

reference_lines.description: Lines across the plot at a value, in the muted tone of the axes. A line outside the data extends its axis to hold it.

axis.description: The axis the value is on. y_secondary needs a series on the secondary axis (a cross-check the widget runs). Without it, y.

value.description: A number on a value axis (on a percent stacked axis, a share from 0 to 1; on a log axis, above zero); on a time x axis, an ISO 8601 date-time string, a bare YYYY-MM-DD date read as its UTC midnight (a date of the calendar: 2026-02-30 fails), or a number of epoch milliseconds, as a point's x there; a category on a category x axis. A string anywhere else, a number on a category x axis, or a value outside these rules fails a cross-check the widget runs.

label.description: Text written at the line's end.

types.title: PieChartRender
types.description: Render of a pie_chart widget: its presentation fields, closed.

radius.description: Optional outer radius, or inner and outer radius, each a percentage or a pixel value, for example ["50%", "70%"] for a donut or ["60px"]. Two items make a donut.

legend_position.description: none hides the legend. Without it, bottom.

drill_down.description: Whether the chart offers its data view and opens it from a click on a segment. Without it, false.

center.description: total writes the sum of the slice values, formatted by value_format, in the middle of a donut; it needs a radius of two items with an inner radius above 0 (a cross-check the widget runs, cpt-frontx-dashboard-algo-widget-catalog-card-checks). Without it, none.

center_label.description: Optional short caption under the total. Allowed with center total only (a cross-check the widget runs).

types.title: HeatmapRender
types.description: Render of a heatmap widget: its presentation fields, closed.

min_value.description: Optional lower end of the colour scale. Null or absent takes the lowest value in the rows. When both ends are set, it is not greater than max_value (a cross-check the widget runs, cpt-frontx-dashboard-algo-widget-catalog-heatmap-checks).

max_value.description: Optional upper end of the colour scale. Null or absent takes the highest value in the rows.

show_cell_values.description: Whether to show each cell's value inside the cell.

mode.description: matrix draws the x categories by the y categories. calendar draws one tile per day: a column per week, a row per weekday, the month names over the columns; every row's x is then a YYYY-MM-DD date and its y is omitted or null (a cross-check the widget runs, cpt-frontx-dashboard-algo-widget-catalog-heatmap-checks). Without it, matrix.

week_start.description: Calendar mode only: the weekday each week column starts on. Set with the matrix mode, it fails the widget's cross-check. Without it, monday.

drill_down.description: Whether the heatmap offers its data view and opens it from a click on a tile; the tiles are then buttons. Without it, false.

types.title: MarkdownCardRender
types.description: Render of a markdown_card widget: its presentation fields, closed.

body.description: The markdown to show: CommonMark, including links and images. Embedded HTML is shown as text.
